name: @george43g/chrome-extension
description: browser-tab connector — Chrome MV3 extension. Streams tab/window state to the browser-tab daemon over a localhost WebSocket and executes true state-preserving tab moves (chrome.tabs.move). Load dist/ unpacked via chrome://extensions.

scripts.build: EXT_ENTRY=background vite build && EXT_ENTRY=options vite build && EXT_ENTRY=popup vite build
